audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer misgenders Leona as male nine times ('His engage hunts...', 'his game', 'his flash range', 'Root his engage', 'Trade his all-in window', 'his engage cooldown', etc.) despite Leona being female per champ-data/champ-gender.js.
audit.why: champ-data/champ-gender.js lists 'leona' in the FEMALE array. The owner (Senna) is 'you', so any third-person pronoun refers to Leona and must be 'her'.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two layers had the entire level chart inverted: full phases[0-3].side='Leona' while content win[0-3]='Skill', and full phases[4-6].side='Skill' while content win[4-6]='Leona'.
audit.why: Content's whys[] give specific, kit-grounded reasoning matching Leona's real kit: her all-in needs Zenith Blade (E) to land, which a ranged Senna can deny early with a Q-root, so levels 1-5 are a skill window; her actual spike is Solar Flare (R) at 6, which guarantees the E-Q-R lockdown chain, and that advantage compounds into items. The full layer had the exact opposite assignment on every one of the 7 rows, matching the documented 'side moved to enemy while why still describes the other side winning' defect class.
audit.corrected: Swapped all 7 phases[].side to match content win[], adjusted ratings, and rewrote every why to state Leona's real kit interaction (Zenith Blade denial early, Solar Flare lockdown from 6 on). win[] left untouched — it was already correct.

audit.why: Zenith Blade (E) is correctly identified as an immobilize-then-dash per the kit description ('the last enemy champion struck will be briefly immobilized and Leona will dash to them'), so calling it a root is accurate, not a fabrication.
